description: ann-benchmarks (erikbern/ann-benchmarks) runner, single CPU per run, k=10

deviations: --local instead of docker (no docker on the host); each run.py process pinned to one logical CPU with taskset, OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1. Upstream's docker runner pins each container to one CPU (cpuset), so build and queries are single-core in both cases.
--runs 2 (CI uses 2, the default is 5; best of runs is kept).
Up to 10 runs in parallel on distinct WSL2 cores (upstream's April 2025 refresh ran 31 in parallel). WSL2 presents 11 cores x 2 threads; Windows schedules them on P/E cores, which cannot be pinned.
Competitor run_groups are subsets of upstream config.yml (values unchanged); see competitors.
From about 01:35 to 01:55 host time, another benchmark's four worker processes ran on CPUs 0-6 with about 17 GB RSS (6 GB swap in use); later other sessions' builds ran on some of the same CPUs.

Points come from two passes (00:39-01:32 and 01:35-03:07 host time). hnswlib M-16 (glove, sift) and scann on fashion-mnist are from the first pass; everything else, including all HMS points (commit below) and a forced re-run of scann on glove and sift, is from the second.
glass caches its graph by (dim, R, L): the glove R-32 graph was built in the first pass (1,110 s) and loaded in the second, so its build_s here is the load time.
faiss-ivfpqfs on sift was stopped at the cutoff; the points it finished are included.

The host has AVX2 and AVX-VNNI but no AVX-512, so glass, faiss and HMS (which has an AVX-512 VNNI kernel) all run their AVX2 paths, unlike the AVX-512 machine of the published ann-benchmarks results; published rankings do not carry over.

hms.runs: degree 32 and 64 on glove-100-angular; degree 32 on sift-128-euclidean; 32/48/64 on fashion-mnist

competitors.hnswlib: nmslib/hnsw branch denorm 4b2cb72 built from source (as upstream Dockerfile); run_groups M-16, M-36 (fashion-mnist: all)
competitors.glass: pyglass tag v1.0 built from source with -march=native and pybind11 2.10.4 (the PyPI glassppy 1.0.5 wheel needs AVX-512 and dies with SIGILL here); R 32/64 on glove, R 32 on sift, all on fashion-mnist
competitors.scann: scann 1.4.2 (PyPI, as upstream Dockerfile); all upstream run_groups
competitors.faiss-ivfpqfs: faiss-cpu 1.15.1 (PyPI; upstream uses conda faiss-cpu with MKL)
competitors.hnswlib_glove_caveat: Unvalidated: on glove-100-angular hnswlib reaches recall 0.9 only at M-36 with 419 QPS, about 7x below scann here, whereas the published April 2025 plot has hnswlib about 2x below scann. Do not use these glove points for HMS-vs-hnswlib claims.

noise.method: QPS ratio of HMS settings doing identical work (ef <= 64, rerank 64 vs 2000)
noise.note: Only within-run noise is measured; variation between runs made at different times on this host was not measured from committed data. Treat QPS ratios within 1.37x as ties.
